settings.title: Lyrics timing analysis (experimental)
settings.notice: For local research trials only. Timing accuracy hasn't been checked by people yet, and the licensing scope for using and distributing the model weights and dictionaries is still being clarified.
settings.toolDescription: Estimates part timing for Chinese, Japanese and English lyrics. Requires the Utawakui-managed audio conversion tool.
settings.size: About 0.78 GB to download and 1.00 GB installed. Keep 4 GB free.
settings.previewRequirement: Choose “Utawakui managed version” under Local audio processing → Tools and models → Audio conversion tool. Analysis uses HubertFA and Whisper small; lyrics audio assist isn't available yet.
settings.previewLimit: Each analysis covers about 30 seconds and up to 10 lines. Results are previewed here only.

preview.source: Lyrics source: {source}. Your chosen source is used first; otherwise one is picked by language.
preview.label: Analysis result preview
preview.hint: Original word timing is used first; when the analysis doesn't fit, the whole line is shown. This is a preview only and isn't applied to the lyrics or performance screen.
preview.contradiction: The analysis doesn't match the lyrics, so the whole line is shown.
preview.missing: Some lyrics may be missing. Play to check.

acoustic.title: Lyrics audio assist
acoustic.description: Tools needed for lyrics analysis, managed separately from experimental features.
acoustic.removePendingHint: The last removal didn't finish. Remove again to clean up what's left. Your lyrics still work.
acoustic.blockedNotice: Model use and distribution terms are being confirmed, so downloads aren't offered yet.

errors.status: Couldn't read lyrics audio assist. Reload.
errors.operation: The lyrics audio assist action didn't finish. Your lyrics still work.
errors.cancel: Cancelling didn't finish. Reload the status later.

queue.title: Analyze lyrics after accompaniment finishes
queue.guidance: Analyzes newly finished accompaniments. Check results, retry and apply on the lyrics page. Tools aren't downloaded and the original lyrics aren't changed automatically.
queue.autoLabel: Automatically analyze lyrics after accompaniment finishes

errors.read: Couldn't read the analysis status. Try again.
errors.operation: The action didn't finish. Your accompaniment and lyrics still work.

errors.status: Couldn't read the lyrics analysis tools. Restart the app or try again.
errors.inspect: Couldn't read this song's timed lyrics. Check the library, lyrics source and track length.
errors.cancelled: Analysis cancelled. Your lyrics still work.
errors.failed: Analysis didn't finish. Prepare FFmpeg, or download the lyrics analysis tools again to repair them. Your lyrics still work.
errors.cancel: Cancelling didn't finish. Reload the status.

analysis.nativeOnly: Word timing already exists; no analysis needed.
analysis.needsTimed: Add lyrics with sync timing first.
analysis.needsProcessing: Turn on audio processing in Settings first.
analysis.needsExperiment: Turn on experimental lyrics analysis in Settings first. Tools aren't downloaded automatically.
analysis.needsTools: Prepare or repair the lyrics analysis tools in Settings first.
analysis.savingOffset: Saving the timing; analysis can start when it finishes.
analysis.offsetFailed: Retry saving the timing before analyzing.
analysis.failed: Analysis failed. Your lyrics and accompaniment still work; you can analyze again.
analysis.cancelled: Analysis cancelled. Your lyrics and accompaniment still work.

skipped.sourceChanged: The lyrics source changed. Analyze again.
skipped.languageUnknown: Couldn't detect the language. Choose the main language and retry; mixed-language lines keep their line timing.
skipped.languageUnsupported: Chinese, Japanese and English are supported. Choose an analysis language.
skipped.lyricsMissing: Add lyrics with sync timing first.
skipped.untimedLyrics: These lyrics have no line timing to analyze.
skipped.unsupportedLyrics: No single-language lines to analyze; line timing is kept.
skipped.environmentMissing: Prepare the lyrics analysis tools in Settings first.
skipped.other: Can't analyze. Check the lyrics language and sync timing.

analysis.reanalyze: Timing changed. Analyze again; source timing is used for now.
analysis.summary: {state} · {lines}. Uncovered parts use the original lyrics.
analysis.reused: Reuses the earlier analysis; timing unchanged.
analysis.missingLyrics: {count} line may be missing words. Check before applying. | {count} lines may be missing words. Check before applying.
analysis.noUsable: No part timing to apply; the original timing is kept. You can analyze again.
analysis.label: Lyrics analysis for the current source
analysis.afterHint: After analysis, turn on Analysis display.
analysis.details: Analyzes Chinese, Japanese or English lyrics, using original word timing first; lines that can't be analyzed keep line timing. Analyze again after changing the source or timing, and play to check the results. The reading view underlines the current part; Focus and Karaoke support continuous fill.
